components.name: bg_alveoli
components.description: Inside the lung: a bunch of translucent air sacs (alveoli) like grapes across the top half, fed by a small airway, sitting on a capillary that runs left → right along the bottom (lane centre y ≈ 760, put ch_rbc_cell anchors around y 850). The capillary turns from plum (left, low oxygen) to red (right, oxygenated). Air sacs hold drifting O2 specks. Use ch_gas_bubble actors to show O2 going down into the blood and CO2 rising out

params.name: breathe
params.description: breaths per second (sacs swell and shrink)

components.name: bg_circulation_map
components.description: Hand-painted diagram of the whole body's two blood loops on paper: faint body silhouette (x 660–1260), heart at (960,530), two lungs at (800,320) and (1120,320). Small loop heart → lungs → heart (blue going up, red coming back); big loop heart → body → heart (red going down, blue coming back). A little red-cell dot can travel the loops. Leave x 1350–1850 free for the presenter and labels (label spots: 心脏 960,470 · 肺 800,190 · 全身 960,960 is under subtitles, use 1240,860)

params.name: show
params.description: which loop is drawn strongly (the other stays faint)

params.name: dot
params.description: which path the red-cell dot travels

params.name: progress
params.description: dot position along its path (animate 0 → 1)

components.name: bg_day_meadow_bg
components.description: A wide watercolour daytime meadow landscape: pale blue sky washes with a soft sun and drifting clouds, a blue-grey mountain ridge fading into a haze band, a tree line on rolling green hills, and a flowered foreground meadow with swaying grass blades, birds and pollen. It is 1920×1080 px, anchored at the bottom centre, and works as a full-bleed backdrop for outdoor daytime scenes. The near meadow ground line is about y 1000, with a good standing band around y 980-1040.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts cloud drift, bird bobbing and grass sway, so multiple copies of the scene do not move in sync.

params.name: clouds
params.description: Cloud amount; 0 removes the clouds entirely and any value above 0 draws the three drifting cloud clusters.

components.name: bg_dusk
components.description: Sunset hillside: violet-to-peach sky, big low sun behind the hills (≈ 960,610), rose clouds, warm hills, grass and a few flowers; ground ≈ y 800, standing band y 840–900; warm, gathering / ending mood

params.name: sun
params.description: the big setting sun

params.name: sunY
params.description: sun height (larger = lower, more set)

components.name: bg_forest_hills_bg
components.description: A soft watercolour landscape background with a warm sky, sun glow, layered blue-green hills, drifting mist bands, a row of small trees and a grassy foreground slope with swaying blades. Sized 1920×1080 with a bottom-centre anchor, it works as a reusable scenic backdrop behind characters or objects. Near ground line is about y 960 (a gently sloping grass bank), with a good standing band around y 960-1040.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the slow mist and grass sway animation; useful for desynchronising multiple copies.

params.name: sun
params.description: Controls the sun glow and disc, from hidden at 0 to full at 1.

components.name: bg_heart_pump
components.description: Cross-section of the heart as a four-room pump (viewer left = the body's right side): right atrium RA (640,390), right ventricle RV (700,720), left atrium LA (1280,390), left ventricle LV (1230,720, thickest wall). Right side holds plum (low-oxygen) blood, left side red. Vessels: vena cava enters RA from the top-left (≈ 380,120), pulmonary artery leaves the top-right of RV straight up between RA and the septum (x ≈ 905; RV exit ≈ 880,600), pulmonary vein enters LA from the top-right (≈ 1540,140), aorta leaves LV upward (≈ 1060,90). Atria squeeze, then ventricles; valves between atrium and ventricle open and shut with the beat. Rooms are painted light so a ch_rbc_cell (scale ≈ 0.75, anchor ≈ room centre y + 70) reads clearly inside

params.name: beat
params.description: beats per second (0 = still)

params.name: highlight
params.description: glow on one room or one side

params.name: squeeze
params.description: extra manual squeeze of the highlighted room (animate for a big "thump")

components.name: bg_meadow
components.description: Sunny spring meadow: pale blue sky, three rolling green hills, grass tufts and scattered flowers; ground line ≈ y 800, good standing band y 820–900

params.name: sun
params.description: draw the sun (top right); turn off to place a pr_sun_moon prop yourself

params.name: clouds

params.name: flowers
params.description: flower density

components.name: bg_night
components.description: Starry night meadow: deep indigo sky with twinkling stars, glowing moon (≈ 1500,220), dark blue hills and grass, optional fireflies; ground ≈ y 800, standing band y 840–900; tint critters with emotion sleepy / calm

params.name: moon
params.description: the moon with its halo

params.name: stars
params.description: star density

params.name: fireflies
params.description: firefly count (0 = none, 1 = about a dozen)

components.name: bg_night_camp_bg
components.description: A watercolour night-campsite backdrop, 1920×1080 with its anchor at the bottom centre: a dark blue sky with twinkling stars and a cratered moon, thin drifting cloud bands, two layered mountain ridges, a row of pine silhouettes, near-black ground, a warm campfire glow at centre-right, and foreground grass with drifting fireflies. Used as a full-frame night scene behind camp, forest or fireside subjects. The near ground line is about y 972 (standing band y 960-1020); the campfire glow sits at about x 1180, y 1010.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the twinkle, cloud drift, flame flicker and firefly cycles, so copies of the background do not animate in sync.

params.name: moon
params.description: Visibility of the moon: at 0 the moon disc and its halo disappear, at 1 the full moon with craters and bright glow is drawn.

params.name: fire
params.description: Strength of the warm campfire glow on the ground at centre-right; 0 removes the glow entirely, 1 gives the brightest flickering pool of light.

components.name: bg_pond
components.description: Quiet pond in a wood: misty sky, band of round trees, grassy bank, wide blue pond (centre ≈ 1180,840, rx 760, ry 230) with drifting ripples; put pr_lotus_leaf props on the water, ch_critter actors on the bank (y 600–700) or on a leaf

params.name: reeds
params.description: cattails at the right edge of the pond

params.name: mist
params.description: morning mist over the trees

components.name: bg_sky_column
components.description: Vertical cross-section of the sky above a meadow, painted as one continuous column so the camera can tilt up and down with cam.cy. Fixed landmarks (never move): grass ground line at y ≈ 830, soft green grass band y 830–1080 with a few tufts and tiny flowers; low warm air y 560–830 in peachy amber with faint heat-shimmer squiggles; mid air y 400–560 pale blue; the cloud bank sits between cloud top y ≈ 150 and cloud base y ≈ 400 (soft grey-white billows, scalloped base fringe); high cold air y 0–150 in violet-grey with a few faint ice specks. Warm ochre sun glow around (1620, 220) when sun = true. A faint column of drifting motes runs up the middle (x 700–1000) so a rising droplet reads as climbing. Put a puddle prop at y ≈ 905 on the grass line. cloudBase and cloudTop map to y = 1000 − value × 1000.

params.description: tilt suggestion: the sky gradient, cloud bank and sun drift by (0.5 − pan) × 120 px; the ground line never moves

params.name: cloudTop

params.name: dark
params.description: thickens and greys the cloud bank; 1 = heavy storm cloud

components.name: bg_vessel
components.description: Inside a blood vessel, flowing left → right: soft wet walls top and bottom, plasma specks drifting with the flow. artery = warm red and wide; vein = plum-blue with a pair of valve flaps at x≈1250; capillary = walls pinch to a narrow lane around y 470–650. Travel lane centre y ≈ 560 (capillary 560); put ch_rbc_cell anchors around y 650 (capillary: 660)

params.name: flow
params.description: flow speed of the plasma specks (artery near the heart ≈ 3)

params.name: valve
params.description: vein only: valve opening (1 open for forward flow, 0 shut against backflow)

components.name: ch_butterfly
components.description: Watercolour butterfly with flapping rose / ochre wings and ink antennae; can perch (slow wing breathing) and glow like a little lamp at night. Body centre is 55 px above the anchor; fly it with x/y Tracks

components.name: ch_critter

components.name: ch_dandelion
components.description: A watercolour dandelion with a rosette of sap-green leaves at the base, a thin two-segment stem, and a pale seed head built from layered rings of radiating pappus florets; loose seeds drift off to the right. It is 406×370 px with the anchor at the bottom centre, suited as a meadow or garden plant that sways in the wind.

components.name: ch_gas_bubble

components.name: ch_kite
components.description: A small watercolour diamond kite with bowed edges, ink spars crossing the face and a wavy tail hung with triangular bows; a thin line runs from the kite down to an off-canvas point below. It is 300×340 px with its anchor at the bottom centre, and it suits open-sky or outdoor scenes where it can hang and drift above the ground.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians; shifts the sway, bobbing and tail wave so several kites do not move in unison.

params.name: wind
params.description: Wind strength; increases the tilt angle, the vertical bob, the tail sway and the sag of the string.

params.name: hue
params.description: Palette colour name used for the main kite wash (falls back to rose if unknown); the paper and ochre accent panels stay fixed.

components.name: ch_paper_boat
components.description: A watercolour folded paper boat with a trapezoid hull, crease lines, two triangular sails around a mast and a small rose flag, bobbing and rolling on soft teal ripples above a faint reflection. Anchor is bottom centre, 276×165 px; good as a floating prop on ponds, puddles or shorelines in gentle idle scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the bobbing, rolling, ripple and flag cycles so copies do not move in sync.

components.name: ch_rbc_cell
components.description: Red blood cell character "Xiaohong": a squishy dimpled disc with a face. o2 = 1 is bright red and perky with little blue O2 bubbles riding along; o2 = 0 turns plum-purple and droopy. Body centre is 95 px above the anchor; can squeeze through capillaries

components.name: ch_willow_tree
components.description: A watercolour willow tree with a curved clay trunk, a broad rounded canopy, and long drooping branches, anchored at its bottom centre and measuring 430×480 px. It is suited to outdoor park, riverside, or garden scenes as a ground-standing tree.

components.name: pr_abacus
components.description: A watercolour wooden abacus with a rectangular frame, three horizontal rails and seven painted beads per rail, with beads drifting slightly as if being counted; anchor is bottom centre at 280×220 px. It suits a classroom, playroom or study desk as a small counting prop.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians (default 0); desynchronises the bead-sliding animation between copies.

params.name: calc
params.description: Calc amount (default 1); reserved in this component and currently has no visible effect.

components.name: pr_ac_unit
components.description: A wall-mounted air-conditioning unit seen from the front: a pale rounded casing with a top vent strip, a circular fan grille with three turning blades, a side pipe port, a small nameplate, a blinking indicator light, a metal mounting bracket and a thin drain hose. Anchored at the bottom centre at 250×210 px, it suits building facades, alley walls and rooftop scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offset in radians for the blade spin and blinking light, used to desynchronise several copies.

params.name: spin

components.name: pr_alarm_clock
components.description: A watercolour twin-bell alarm clock with a round paper face, twelve tick marks, three hands, and a small base; when ringing it shakes and emits orange sound waves. It is 220×210 px with its anchor at bottom centre, suited to bedside, desk, or shelf props in a domestic scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the animation timing in radians so multiple clocks tick and ring out of sync.

params.name: ringing
params.description: Controls how strongly the clock shakes, the bells beat, and the ring waves appear; 0 is still and 1 is a full alarm.

components.name: pr_awning
components.description: A watercolour shop awning with a wide striped canopy, scalloped valance, two side support poles, and a small hanging string of lights. It is anchored at the bottom centre and sized 340×190 px, making it suitable for storefronts, café facades, or market scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that desynchronises the swaying and light twinkle between copies.

params.name: billow
params.description: Controls the amount of canopy and valance movement, from still at 0 to full billow at 1.

params.name: hue

components.name: pr_backpack
components.description: A watercolour backpack drawn as a rounded pack body with two side pockets, a folded paper-coloured top flap and ochre buckle, curved shoulder straps, a top grab handle, a small orange patch and dashed base stitching. It measures 190×230 px with the anchor at the bottom centre, and works as ground-standing luggage or carried gear in a travel, school or hiking scene.

params.name: breathe
params.description: Amount of idle breathing squash-and-stretch; 0 keeps the pack perfectly still.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians for the breathing cycle, so several copies do not pulse in sync.

params.name: hue
params.description: Palette colour key used for the bag body and side pockets (default 'sap' green); unknown keys fall back to 'sap'.

components.name: pr_beat_lamp
components.description: Little paper lantern on a wooden post that flashes warm gold every time a swing (pr_mv_swing) passes its lowest point — the beat of the swing made visible (it follows film time, so it is always in step with pr_mv_swing). miss tints the flash violet ("you missed the beat"). Lantern ~ 230 px above the anchor

components.name: pr_bicycle
components.description: A side-view watercolour bicycle with two spoked wheels, a diamond frame in teal/rose/ochre, saddle, swept handlebar with bell and headlamp, plus a rear rack and mudguard. It is 430×290 px with the anchor at the bottom centre, sized to sit on a road, lane or path as a parked or ridden street prop.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the pedal and wheel rotation, used to desynchronise multiple copies.

params.name: ride

params.name: frame
params.description: Colour of the bicycle frame wash.

components.name: pr_bird_house
components.description: A watercolour birdhouse on a short clay post: ochre plank box with a rose pitched roof, dark round entrance hole, a perch, and small flowers at the base, with a teal bird hopping beside it. It sways gently around its bottom-centre anchor and measures 200×330 px, making it a good garden or yard focal prop behind lower foreground elements.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offset in radians that shifts the sway, bird hop and flower wiggle cycle, so several copies do not move in sync.

params.name: bird

components.name: pr_body_cell

components.name: pr_boulder_rock
components.description: A watercolour boulder with a faceted grey-brown stone body, light and dark rock planes, ink crack lines, a moss cap along the top ridge, and small pebbles and grass at its base. params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the breathing and moss-sway animation timing, useful for desynchronising multiple copies.

params.name: moss
params.description: Controls how much moss grows along the top ridge, from none at 0 to full moss cover at 1.

components.name: pr_bowl_chopsticks
components.description: A watercolour bowl of rice with blue floral banding, two chopsticks resting across the rim, and soft animated steam; anchor is bottom centre and size is 250×190 px. It works as tableware on a tabletop or ground-level meal scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the chopstick wobble and steam animation, useful for desynchronising multiple bowls.

params.name: steam
params.description: Controls steam strength; 0 hides steam, 1 is the default, and 2 gives stronger steam.

components.name: pr_bread_basket
components.description: A watercolour bread basket with a woven oval body, arched handle, baguettes, round rolls, a lining cloth and a draped napkin. It is 400×320 px with its anchor at the bottom centre, and is suited to kitchen, market or tabletop scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians; desynchronises the handle sway and steam animation between copies.

params.name: full
params.description: Fill level; above 0.4 shows the handle and steam, at or below 0.4 hides them while the bread remains visible.

components.name: pr_bread_loaf
components.description: A watercolour rustic bread loaf with a browned scored top, pale air holes on its side, a rose cloth draped at its base, a leaning cut slice on the right and a few scattered crumbs. Anchor is bottom centre, 314×160 px, sized for a bakery counter, breakfast table or picnic still life.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the gentle breathing sway of the cut slice, so copies desynchronise.

params.name: slices

components.name: pr_broom
components.description: A straw broom with a long pale wooden handle, a hanging ring at the top, and a trapezoidal brush head bound with a clay-coloured band, its straw strands drawn individually and small dust puffs at the tips. params.name: sway

components.name: pr_bus_stop_sign
components.description: A slim grey pole rising from a small ground shadow, topped with a round teal disc showing a simple bus, and a cream timetable panel clamped to its right side with coloured route blocks, six time rows and a small status lamp. The anchor is bottom centre at 220×350 px, making it a roadside marker for street, pavement or transit-stop scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the gentle sway of the disc and panel and the blinking of the status lamp, so repeated signs do not move in sync.

params.name: arrive
params.description: Fades in an orange glow and lamp at the bottom of the timetable, indicating an arriving bus; 0 leaves the lamp as a plain grey dot.

components.name: pr_bush_cluster
components.description: A watercolour bush cluster made of rounded green leaf lobes on short woody stems, with scattered leaves, a soft shadow, and optional red berries that sway in the wind. It is anchored at the bottom centre and sized 300×240 px, useful as garden undergrowth or a layered foreground/background plant in a scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians; shifts the wind cycle so copies sway out of sync.

params.name: wind
params.description: Wind strength; 0 holds still, higher values increase leaf and branch sway.

params.name: berries

components.name: pr_bystander_crowd
components.description: A watercolour crowd prop showing five dark, anonymous bystanders with question-mark thought bubbles around a small rose-clad figure raising a heart, with orange distress ripples and faint gaze arrows. params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that desynchronises the crowd's bobbing, waving, and ripple animation across copies.

params.name: help
params.description: Help amount; higher values fade the central figure's orange distress ripples, with 0 showing full ripples and 1 hiding them.

components.name: pr_cable_tangle
components.description: A watercolour pile of tangled cables with three overlapping coiled loops in charcoal, rose and teal, plus a USB-C plug, an HDMI plug, a headphone jack and a velcro strap. Anchored at bottom centre and 400×260 px, it suits cluttered desk, drawer or studio-floor props.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the wobble animation timing so multiple copies move out of sync.

params.name: knot
params.description: Controls how much the coils sway and shift; 0 keeps the tangle still, 1 gives the full wobble.

components.name: pr_camera
components.description: A watercolour camera with a dark grey body, round lens with focus-ring ticks, viewfinder hump, ochre shutter button, dial, flash window and a looped carry strap. params.name: strap

components.name: pr_campfire
components.description: A watercolour campfire built from two crossed logs with pale ring-marked ends, a ring of grey stones, and layered orange-to-cream flame tongues that flicker and throw a warm glow. params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the flicker, sway, and ember motion in radians, so multiple campfires can be placed without animating in sync.

params.name: embers
params.description: Controls the number and brightness of floating sparks above the flames; 0 removes them entirely, 1 gives the full drifting ember trail.

components.name: pr_car_ev
components.description: A side-view watercolour electric car with a long teardrop body, a single dark glass canopy, two spinning spoked wheels, thin LED light strips front and rear, and a charging port with four glowing charge-level bars. It measures 470×200 px with the anchor at the bottom centre, and works as a ground-level vehicle in street or traffic scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the wheel spin, body bob and light flicker so several copies do not animate in sync.

params.name: speed
params.description: Animation rate for wheel rotation and body bob; above 0.2 the lamps glow and above 0.4 trailing slipstream lines appear behind the car.

params.name: charge
params.description: Battery level that lights up the four charge indicator bars beside the charging port, from none to all four.

components.name: pr_car_sedan
components.description: A watercolour sedan with a boxy body, trapezoid cabin, pale windows, two spoked wheels, bumpers, lights and door details; anchor is bottom centre, 470×215 px. It suits street traffic, parked curbside, or roadside scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the bobbing and wheel-spin animation to desynchronise copies.

params.name: speed
params.description: Scales the bobbing and wheel rotation; above 0.2 also adds a headlight glow.

params.name: body
params.description: Selects the body wash colour: rose, sky blue, or ochre.

components.name: pr_car_vintage
components.description: A watercolour side view of a vintage automobile with a rounded cabin, two split windows, spoked wheels under curved fenders, a chrome grille, a headlamp, a rear spare tyre and a running board. The 450×260 px prop is anchored at its bottom centre and gently bobs with spinning wheels, making it suitable for period street scenes or a parked vehicle at the kerb.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the bobbing and wheel-spin cycle in radians so several copies do not move in sync.

params.name: speed
params.description: Animation rate: higher values bob and spin the wheels faster, brighten the headlamp glow and add dust puffs behind the car.

params.name: body
params.description: Paint colour of the bodywork; teal-green, dusty rose or warm ochre, each with a matching darker shade for shading.

components.name: pr_certificate
components.description: A watercolour paper certificate with a cream sheet, double gold inner border, title and body lines, a red circular stamp, and a rose ribbon seal, anchored at bottom centre and sized 280×230 px. It is suited for desk or wall displays in award, office, or ceremony scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that desynchronises the gentle flutter and stamp pulse between copies.

params.name: stamp
params.description: Stamp amount; 0 hides the red circular stamp, while higher values show it with a subtle pulse.

components.name: pr_cleaver_board
components.description: A watercolour chopping board with a carrot lying on it and a cleaver that rises and falls through a looping chopping cycle, leaving a cut slice and scattered crumbs. The anchor is bottom centre and the size is 420×366 px, making it a ready-made kitchen counter prop for cooking scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the chopping cycle so multiple copies animate out of sync.

params.name: rhythm
params.description: Speed of the chopping cycle; 0 freezes the knife, 1 gives the full chopping tempo.

params.name: force
params.description: Strength of the impact effects: board shake, blade bounce and crumb scatter.

params.name: view
params.description: Camera view: side profile, 45-degree oblique with board depth, or top-down plan view.

components.name: pr_cloud
components.description: Soft watercolour puff cloud that slowly breathes; centre is 85 px above the anchor. Move it with an x Track; can rain

params.name: tint
params.description: colour for day, dusk, overcast or night skies

params.name: rain
params.description: ink rain streaks below the cloud

components.name: pr_coffee_cup
components.description: A watercolour coffee cup resting on a round saucer, with a slim side handle, dark coffee surface, a small coral ring motif on the body, and three animated steam wisps rising above the rim. Anchored at the bottom centre and 184×212 px, it suits café tables, breakfast still lifes, or a warm foreground prop in an interior scene.

params.name: steam
params.description: Strength of the rising steam wisps; 0 removes them entirely, higher values make the curls more visible.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians for the steam animation, used to desynchronise multiple copies of the cup.

components.name: pr_coin_jar
components.description: Glass money jar with a cork, pale blue watercolour glass and ink outline; golden coins pile up inside (coins 0–24). When coins goes up, the new coin drops in from above the mouth and lands with a glint; when lost goes up, a coin pops out of the mouth and tumbles away (step coins down at the same key). leak 0..1 cracks the bottom and lets coins seep out. Jar 180 px wide, mouth at ~ 280 px above the anchor

params.name: coins
params.description: coins inside (step it up: each step drops one coin in)

params.name: glow
params.description: warm glow when the jar matters

params.name: lost
params.description: coins thrown out so far (step it up: each step pops one coin out of the mouth)

params.name: leak
params.description: crack in the bottom: coins seep out (0 = none)

components.name: pr_crosswalk
components.description: A watercolour zebra crossing seen in perspective: a grey asphalt trapezoid framed by pale curbs, seven white stripes narrowing toward the far end, a stop line and small ochre lane dashes, with optional shimmering wet reflections. Anchored at the bottom centre at 420×200 px, it works as a flat ground prop for street, town or rainy-night scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians for the wet-reflection shimmer, used to desynchronise copies of the crosswalk.

params.name: wet
params.description: Amount of wetness; above 0 adds soft sky-coloured water glints on the asphalt that grow stronger with the value.

components.name: pr_cumulus_cloud
components.description: A soft watercolour cumulus cloud built from overlapping rounded puffs, with a broad flat base, pale shadow washes and broken ink outline strokes; it drifts and bobs gently. Anchor is bottom centre at 440×300 px, good for filling skies, horizon backdrops and open landscape scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the drift and bob cycle so multiple clouds do not move in sync.

params.name: drift
params.description: Strength of the horizontal sway and puff bobbing; 0 holds the cloud still, higher values make it move more.

params.name: tone
params.description: Colour scheme: 'day' uses cool white and blue-grey washes, 'dusk' uses warm cream and peach shadows.

components.name: pr_cushion
components.description: A plump square cushion with rounded, slightly drooping corners, a dimpled centre button, an inner seam and small tassels at each corner, painted in loose watercolour washes with a soft shadow beneath. It is 320×270 px with the anchor at the bottom centre, and works as a soft furnishing on a sofa, bed, bench or floor in a scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that desynchronises the cushion's slow breathing wobble between copies.

params.name: color
params.description: Fabric colour of the cushion body and button: rose, teal or ochre.

params.name: squash
params.description: How far the animated breathing motion compresses and widens the body; 0 keeps it rigid, 1 gives full squash.

components.name: pr_desk_calendar
components.description: A watercolour desk calendar standing on a small triangular easel, with a spiral-bound page showing a teal month header, a 7×5 date grid, a rose ring marking the current day, and a small pencil leaning beside it. Anchor is bottom centre at 320×320 px, good for cluttering office desks, shop counters or study scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that desynchronises the gentle page sway and the day-marker pulse between copies.

params.name: day
params.description: Which date cell is highlighted with the rose ring; values are rounded to the nearest day.

params.name: flip
params.description: Amount of loose page showing at the right edge, animating as a small fluttering flip; 0 hides it.

components.name: pr_desk_lamp
components.description: A watercolour desk lamp with a round base, two-segment articulated arm and ochre shade, shown with a glowing bulb and soft light cone when switched on. Anchor is bottom centre at 250×270 px, suitable for desks, studies and indoor interior scenes.

params.name: on
params.description: Turns the bulb glow and light cone on (1) or off (0).

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that desynchronises flicker and sway between copies.

params.name: aim
params.description: Adds to the arm sway angle, tilting the lamp head and light direction.

components.name: pr_desk_lamp_arm
components.description: A watercolour clamp-on desk lamp with a two-segment articulated arm, coil spring, joint discs and conical shade, shown with an optional warm glow and light cone. Anchor is bottom centre, 386×340 px; useful for office, study or workbench scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians; desynchronises the lamp's sway and flicker from other copies.

params.name: on
params.description: Turns the lamp light on or off; values above 0.2 show the glow and light cone, with brightness scaling.

params.name: tilt
params.description: Tilt amount added to the arm and shade, changing the lamp's lean and light direction.

components.name: pr_desk_organizer
components.description: A watercolour desk organizer: a tapered clay-coloured box with three compartments, holding pens and scissors that poke up from the back and a ruler, sticky notes and a small clip in the front slot, all sitting on a soft shadow. Anchored at the bottom centre at 260×220 px, it is a compact prop for a study, office or classroom tabletop scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the gentle pen and scissor sway, so several copies do not wobble in sync.

params.name: hue
params.description: Palette colour used for the wash of the organizer body.

components.name: pr_desktop_monitor
components.description: A watercolour desktop monitor with a dark bezel, pale stand, power light, and a screen showing either abstract canvas swatches, code lines, or a landscape photo. It is 360×310 px with its anchor at the bottom centre, suited to desk and office scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians used to desynchronise screen flicker between copies.

params.name: on
params.description: Screen on/off amount; 1 shows the screen content and glow, 0 leaves it dark.

params.name: screen
params.description: Screen content style: abstract canvas swatches, code lines, or a landscape photo.

components.name: pr_dice
components.description: Two watercolour dice resting on the ground: a tilted back die showing five pips and a larger front die drawn in three-quarter perspective with visible top, front and side faces showing 2, 6 and 3 pips. Both are cream-coloured with terracotta pips and a soft shadow, anchored at bottom centre and sized 220×180 px, with a gentle rolling pulse good for tabletop, game or chance-themed scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the gentle bobbing/rolling pulse so multiple copies move out of sync.

params.name: roll
params.description: Strength of the rolling pulse; 0 keeps the dice still, 1 gives the full bounce.

components.name: pr_dirt_mound
components.description: A rounded watercolour dirt mound with a sunlit top, shaded right flank, scattered clods, cracks, small pebbles and a few blades of grass at its base; at full freshness a trowel stands buried in the soil and a worm trail is visible. Anchor is bottom centre at 340×200 px, sized to sit on the ground line as a digging or garden prop in a scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the wobble of the mound's top contour, used to desynchronise several copies so they do not look identical.

params.name: fresh
params.description: How freshly dug the mound looks; above 0.5 a worm trail and a trowel stuck in the soil are drawn, below that the mound reads as settled.

params.name: pebbles
params.description: Opacity and presence of the small grey stones scattered over the mound surface; 0 removes them entirely.

components.name: pr_dish_soap
components.description: A pale teal watercolour dish-soap bottle with a pump dispenser, white label and green liquid showing through, standing on a soft shadow ring beside a yellow sponge with a green scouring pad and a few floating bubbles. Anchor is bottom centre at 340×330 px, sized for kitchen counter or sink-side scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the bubble bobbing cycle, used to desynchronise multiple copies.

params.name: bubbles
params.description: Amount of foam and floating bubbles around the bottle; 0 hides them entirely.

params.name: level
params.description: How full the bottle is, controlling the opacity of the green liquid wash inside.

components.name: pr_dominoes
components.description: Watercolour dominoes: two cream tiles stand upright with inked pips and a third lies fallen beside them, with soft shadow and faint pip ghosts. The anchor is bottom centre at 240×170 px, making it suitable for tabletop, game, or play scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians; changes the timing of the wobble and ghost-pip animation to desynchronise copies.

params.name: fall
params.description: Controls the amount of falling/wobble motion and the visibility of the floating ghost pips.

components.name: pr_door_glass
components.description: A watercolour shop door with a dark metal frame, a glass leaf that swings inward to reveal warm interior light, a hanging OPEN sign and two ochre push handles, with a small floor mat at the threshold. Anchor is bottom centre, 268×410 px, sized for storefront facades and street-level entrances in a scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offset in radians that shifts the idle sway and the swinging of the OPEN sign, so several copies do not move in sync.

params.name: open
params.description: How far the glass leaf is pushed inward, from fully shut (0) to swung open at roughly 0.3 rad (1); also enables the swaying motion.

params.name: neon
params.description: Strength of the warm interior glow and the teal neon on the OPEN sign; at 0 the sign lines turn plain dark ink.

components.name: pr_door_metal
components.description: A watercolour industrial metal door set in a grey concrete frame, with rivets, a wire-mesh viewing window, push bar, warning sign, and optional red alarm lamp; anchor bottom centre, 256×390 px. Useful as a secure entrance or backdrop element in urban, prison, or factory scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the alarm lamp's pulse timing so multiple doors blink out of sync.

params.name: open
params.description: Swings the door leaf outward on its hinge from shut (0) to fully open (1).

params.name: alarm
params.description: Turns on the red alarm lamp and its pulsing glow; 0 hides it, 1 gives maximum glow.

components.name: pr_door_wood
components.description: A watercolour wooden front door with a pale frame, panelled leaf, metal hinges and handle, house-number plate, mail slot, stone step, doormat, and a small potted plant; anchor is bottom centre at 280×400 px. It is suited to a building facade or street entrance in a scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Shifts the timing of the plant's sway so copies do not move in sync.

params.name: open
params.description: Rotates the door leaf inward from shut to fully open, revealing a warm glow behind.

params.name: welcome
params.description: Controls the doormat and, above 0.5, shows the small potted plant beside the step.

components.name: pr_drain_pipe
components.description: A watercolour exterior drain pipe with a top hopper, clamped vertical downpipe, bottom elbow spout, animated trickle and puddle, wall stains, moss and optional climbing ivy. Anchor is bottom centre, 170×420 px, and it is good for building facades, alleys and courtyard walls.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians for the water and ivy animation; use different values to desynchronise repeated pipes.

params.name: flow
params.description: Amount of animated water at the spout: 0 is dry, 1 is a full trickle with puddle.

params.name: ivy
params.description: Amount of climbing ivy: 0 removes the vine, 1 gives full vine and leaves.

components.name: pr_electric_kettle
components.description: A watercolour electric kettle with a rounded body, water-level window, teal lid, side handle, angled spout, base, orange indicator light and two steam wisps. Anchor is bottom centre at 230×215 px; suited to a kitchen counter or tabletop scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians; shifts the bobbing, steam and indicator flicker to desynchronise copies.

params.name: boil
params.description: Boil amount; scales the body bob, steam wisps and indicator glow.

components.name: pr_espresso_mug
components.description: A small watercolour espresso cup with a tapered body and thick loop handle, sitting on a round saucer with a spoon and a sugar cube beside it, topped by two curling steam wisps. Anchored at the bottom centre and roughly 240×210 px, it suits a café tabletop, an office desk, or a kitchen still-life scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the steam animation, used to desynchronise multiple copies.

params.name: steam
params.description: Steam strength; 0 removes the wisps and higher values make them more opaque.

params.name: fill
params.description: Fill amount of the cup, controlling how dark and wide the coffee surface appears.

components.name: pr_fallen_leaves
components.description: A scattered cluster of watercolour autumn leaves — five-lobed maple shapes and oval leaves in ochre, rust and sap green — resting on a soft ground wash with small stones, plus a few leaves drifting above with faint wind lines. Anchor is bottom centre, 400×200 px; good for a forest floor, garden bed or autumn path detail.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the animation cycle so multiple copies drift out of sync.

params.name: wind
params.description: Increases the drift distance and sway of the falling leaves and wind lines.

params.name: count
params.description: Sets visibility and opacity of the airborne leaves and wind lines; 0 hides them, values above 1 remain fully opaque.

components.name: pr_fern_frond
components.description: A watercolour fern clump with several arching pinnate fronds, each built from a curved central stem, paired leaflets and a curled tip, rising from a small ring of earth. Anchored at bottom centre and about 340×300 px, it suits garden beds, forest floor and potted greenery in a scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the wind sway timing in radians so repeated copies do not move in unison.

params.name: wind
params.description: Strength of the side-to-side swaying of the fronds; 0 keeps them still.

params.name: fronds
params.description: Number of fronds drawn (clamped to 1–3 in the drawing code); fewer makes a sparser, smaller clump.

components.name: pr_fire_hydrant
components.description: A watercolour fire hydrant: a tapered red column on a flanged base, with a side outlet cap on each side, a top nozzle, a small dust chain and scattered rust spots. Anchored at the bottom centre and sized 160×210 px, it sits on a pavement or street corner and can be given a slow dripping leak.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that desynchronises the chain sway and drip timing between copies.

params.name: leak
params.description: Amount of leakage: 0 is dry, higher values make two water drops pulse below the left outlet with increasing opacity.

components.name: pr_floor_lamp
components.description: A watercolour floor lamp: a slim dark pole rising from a low round base into a trapezoid fabric shade, with a soft warm glow and a downward light cone when lit, plus a small swinging charm tied to the pole. Anchor is bottom centre at 220×488 px, good as interior decor and a warm light source in room scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians; shifts the flicker, sway and charm swing so copies do not animate in sync.

params.name: on
params.description: Switches the lamp on or off: 1 gives a warm glowing shade with bulb and light cone, 0 gives a dull unlit fabric shade.

components.name: pr_flower_cluster
components.description: A watercolour cluster of daisy, bell and spike flowers with green stems and leaves rising from a soft earth mound; anchored at the bottom centre, 340×300 px. It suits garden borders, meadow foregrounds and decorative ground planting in a scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the wind-sway animation so repeated clusters move out of sync.

params.name: wind
params.description: Controls how far the stems and flower heads sway in the breeze.

params.name: palette
params.description: Selects the flower colour scheme: mixed rose and ochre tones, rose only, or ochre only.

components.name: pr_flower_patch
components.description: A clump of grass tufts and little five-petal flowers swaying in the wind; dress up any ground line or frame a critter

params.name: flowers
params.description: number of flowers

params.name: palette
params.description: flower colours

params.name: grass
params.description: grass colour to match the background

components.name: pr_flower_vase
components.description: A clear glass vase with a narrowed neck, holding stems with leaves and up to three multi-petal blooms, with a translucent blue water wash and white highlight strokes; anchor is bottom centre, 300×360 px. It works as a tabletop or windowsill decor prop in interior and still-life scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the sway and bloom bobbing animation in radians so several copies do not move in sync.

params.name: flowers
params.description: Number of blooms drawn; the drawing clamps it to 1-3, so values above 3 look the same.

params.name: water
params.description: Opacity of the blue water wash inside the vase, from nearly empty to full.

components.name: pr_folder
components.description: A watercolour manila folder with a tab label, three sheets of paper rising out of the top, a pink elastic band across the front, a small yellow sticky note and a folded corner; anchored at the bottom centre at 340×270 px. Useful as a desk or shelf prop in office, study or paperwork scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that desynchronises copies; it shifts the gentle bobbing of the top sheet so repeated folders do not move in unison.

components.name: pr_folding_chair
components.description: A watercolour folding chair with a rose fabric seat and backrest stretched over an X-crossed grey metal frame, finished with ochre hinges and dark foot caps. It sits on a soft shadow, anchored at the bottom centre at 260×300 px, and is good for outdoor cafés, garden or patio scenes, and small gathering props.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that desynchronises the gentle rocking motion between copies of the chair.

params.name: wobble
params.description: Amount of the slow side-to-side rocking sway; 0 keeps the chair still, higher values make it tilt more.

components.name: pr_fridge_magnets
components.description: A watercolour fridge-door panel with a brushed-steel finish, handle and edge trim, scattered round, heart, square and clip magnets, a tilted shopping list and a small photo held by a pin, plus a memo strip near the bottom. Anchor is bottom centre at 340×350 px, sized to sit against a kitchen wall or as an upright appliance prop in a room scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that desynchronises the gentle paper flutter between copies.

params.name: notes
params.description: Amount of pinned paper: at 0 the list and photo are hidden, above 0.1 they fade in fully.

components.name: pr_frying_pan
components.description: A watercolour cast-iron frying pan with a long handle, a fried egg and a strip of bacon inside, plus faint sizzle droplets and steam. Anchor is bottom centre at 300×165 px; suited to kitchen or campfire cooking scenes as a handheld or tabletop prop.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that desynchronises sizzle motion between copies.

params.name: sizzle
params.description: Amount of sizzle animation; 0 hides droplets and steam, 1 gives full motion.

components.name: pr_game_controller
components.description: A watercolour game controller with a pale grey body and two rounded grips, a cross-shaped d-pad on the left, four coloured face buttons on the right, two thumbsticks and small start buttons in the centre panel, and a short cable curling up from the top edge. It is anchored at the bottom centre at 280×170 px and suits a living-room, desk or handheld scene where a character is playing.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the animation cycle in radians, so several controllers shake and blink out of sync.

params.name: playing
params.description: Amount of active play: scales the body shake and the glow on the face buttons; 0 keeps it still and unlit.

components.name: pr_garden_fence
components.description: A watercolour garden fence with two horizontal rails, six pointed pickets, and optional trailing vines, small leaves, and pink flowers. Anchored at bottom centre at 360×170 px, it is suited to garden edges, yard boundaries, and outdoor scene decoration.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the vine sway and flower bob animation; use different values to desynchronise copies.

params.name: vine
params.description: Controls the amount of visible vine, leaves, and flowers; 0 hides them and 1 shows full growth.

components.name: pr_grass_patch
components.description: A watercolour clump of grass made of ten inked tufts with soft green wash patches beneath them and up to three small five-petal flowers on thin stems. It measures 420×180 px with its anchor at the bottom centre, so it sits flush on ground lines and works as low meadow cover or a foreground border in a scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the sway and flower-bob cycle in radians so several copies do not move in unison.

params.name: wind
params.description: Scales how far the grass tips and flower heads lean and drift; 0 gives a still patch, higher values look breezy.

params.name: flowers
params.description: Controls the presence and opacity of the small blossoms; below about 0.2 no flowers are drawn, and larger values make them fully opaque.

components.name: pr_halo_ring
components.description: A small watercolour figure with a rounded head, closed eyes and a faint smile stands beneath a tilted golden halo ring that shimmers with short radiating light strokes. Anchor is bottom centre, 250×260 px; it suits scenes of blessing, virtue or an honoured character.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the halo tilt and shimmer cycle in radians; use it to desynchronise several copies.

params.name: glow
params.description: Strength of the warm glow behind and below the halo; 0 removes it entirely.

components.name: pr_hangers
components.description: A watercolour laundry rail with up to three wooden and metal clothes hangers hanging from it, one or two draped with a washed shirt; a small teal clip basket hangs at the left. Anchor is bottom centre at 420×280 px, good for a bathroom, utility room or laundry corner of a scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the sway animation cycle in radians so repeated copies do not swing in sync.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of hangers drawn; the value is rounded and clamped to 1–3, filling from left to right.

params.name: sway
params.description: Multiplier on the rocking motion of the hangers; 0 keeps them still, higher values swing them more.

components.name: pr_headphones
components.description: Watercolour over-ear headphones with a padded headband, two ear cups, a wavy cable, and a small music player resting beside them. Anchor is bottom centre at 288×240 px, suited to desk, room, or listening-themed scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that desynchronises the sound-wave pulse and cable sway between copies.

params.name: beat
params.description: Controls the strength of the animated sound-wave pulses; 0 disables them.

components.name: pr_iceberg_mind
components.description: A watercolour cross-section of a floating iceberg: a small flagged tip above the waterline, a much larger submerged body with ink cracks and glowing dots, wavy water lines and a sandy seabed at the bottom. Anchored at the bottom centre at 300×320 px, it works as a diagram-like prop for psychology, metaphor or explanatory scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians for the bobbing and ripple animation; use it to desynchronise several copies.

params.name: bob
params.description: Amount of horizontal drift/sway of the iceberg; 0 keeps it still, 1 gives the full motion.

components.name: pr_inkblot
components.description: A cream card holds a symmetric dark inkblot with subtle watercolour shading, faint wet rings, and a soft shadow at its base. It is 250×250 px with a bottom-centre anchor and works as a small prop for a desk, shelf, or psychological scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians; desynchronises the breathing and wet-ring animation between copies.

params.name: wet
params.description: Wetness amount; controls the visibility of the faint animated water rings over the inkblot.

components.name: pr_iron_board
components.description: A watercolour ironing board with crossed X-shaped legs, a cloth-covered top, a laid-out shirt and a small iron that glides back and forth, with optional steam wisps. Anchor is bottom centre, 320×220 px, and it works as a domestic laundry prop in a room or utility scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the iron's glide and steam animation cycle; use different values to desynchronise copies.

params.name: steam
params.description: Controls steam visibility; 0 hides the wisps, values above 0 show the animated steam.

components.name: pr_keyboard
components.description: A watercolour computer keyboard drawn in slight perspective, with four rows of twelve pale keycaps, a wide space bar, a loose cable curling off the right edge and faint teal ripple marks above it. Anchored at the bottom centre at 320×130 px, it suits desk and office scenes where a character types.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the key-press and ripple animation timing in radians so several keyboards in a scene do not move in sync.

params.name: typing
params.description: Amount of typing activity: at 0 the ripples disappear, higher values make the teal press marks above the keys more visible.

components.name: pr_knife_block
components.description: A watercolour wooden knife block with up to three knives slotted into its angled top, a chef's knife lying on the counter in front, and a honing steel leaning at the right; anchor is bottom centre, 300×380 px. It works as a kitchen counter prop beside or behind food-prep scenes.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of knives slotted into the block; the drawing clamps the visible slots to 1–3.

components.name: pr_lantern
components.description: A hanging paper lantern with clay wood caps top and bottom, a curved wire hook and cord, a ribbed ochre paper body with glowing inner core, and a short fringe of tassels below. Anchored at its bottom centre at 150×280 px, it sways gently and suits festival, street or doorway scenes as a hanging light source.

params.name: sway
params.description: Amount of pendulum swing; 0 keeps it still, higher values widen the arc.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offset in radians for the sway and flicker cycles, so several lanterns do not move in sync.

params.name: lit
params.description: Brightness of the inner glow and halo; 0 leaves the paper body unlit.

components.name: pr_laptop
components.description: An open watercolour laptop with a pale screen showing a teal panel, a small orange bar chart and a note card, over a keyboard deck with rows of keys, a touchpad and a teal power light; a teacup and a pen sit on the desk at either side. Anchor is bottom centre, 372×230 px, sized for desk, study or office scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the animation clock so several laptops on screen flicker and breathe out of sync.

params.name: glow
params.description: Strength of the screen backlight and interface overlay; at 0 the screen is dark and blank.

components.name: pr_laundry_basket
components.description: A watercolour wicker laundry basket with a woven body, an elliptical rim and a tall arched handle, holding a few folded clothes that peek above the rim, plus a small laundry tag on the front. Anchor is bottom centre at 280×220 px; good as a floor prop in a laundry room, bathroom or bedroom corner.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the idle breathing and handle sway animation so several baskets in one scene do not move in sync.

params.name: clothes
params.description: Number of clothes bundles showing above the rim; 0 leaves the basket empty and only the inner lining is drawn.

components.name: pr_lotus_leaf
components.description: Flat green lily pad floating on water, with the classic notch and gentle bob; a critter can sit on it: give the leaf a "depth" smaller than the critter y and put the critter feet ≈ 45 px × scale above the leaf anchor

params.name: flower
params.description: a small pink lotus flower on the pad

params.name: bob
params.description: bobbing amount

components.name: pr_love_heart
components.description: A watercolour love heart with a soft rose wash, paper highlight, stitched heartbeat line, and four small orbiting hearts, casting a faint shadow beneath. Anchored at the bottom centre at 230×220 px, it suits romantic or affection-themed scene accents and UI props.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians; shifts the pulse and orbiting-heart positions to desynchronise multiple copies.

params.name: beat
params.description: Heartbeat pulse and glow strength multiplier; 0 removes visible pulsing and glow, higher values make it stronger.

components.name: pr_manhole_cover
components.description: A watercolour street manhole cover seen in perspective: a grey road patch with an elliptical iron seat ring, a darker lid carrying rings of diamond anti-slip treads, a small central hole, edge highlight, hairline cracks and optional drifting steam plumes. It measures 220×120 px with the anchor at the bottom centre and works as ground-level street dressing or a subtle steaming vent in a scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that desynchronises the steam animation between copies.

params.name: steam
params.description: Steam strength; 0 removes the plumes entirely, higher values thicken and lift the wisps.

components.name: pr_maslow_pyramid
components.description: A watercolour Maslow hierarchy pyramid built from five stacked trapezoid tiers topped by a small triangle holding a heart, each tier carrying a small white pictogram (bowl, house, two figures, star, heart) and a soft glow when lit. Anchor is bottom centre, 300×280 px, and it works as a tabletop chart or classroom prop in explanatory or diagram scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the pulsing glow cycle, used to desynchronise multiple copies.

params.name: level
params.description: Controls how many tiers are lit and glowing (level divided by 5, clamped); higher values light more tiers from the bottom up.

components.name: pr_mech_keyboard
components.description: A watercolour mechanical keyboard drawn in near-top view: a dark rounded case with a recessed key bed, four staggered rows of pale keycaps plus a bottom row with a wide spacebar, a rose accent key, three indicator lights, a small knob and a braided cable trailing down from the left. Keys depress and rebound in a single-key typing rhythm, with a soft teal glow at bottom-out; anchor is bottom centre, 400×150 px, sized for a desk or office scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the typing clock and knob wobble, so several copies do not press keys in sync.

params.name: typing
params.description: Typing speed/amount: scales the keystroke rate from still (0) up to about five presses per second (1); 0 also stops the indicator flicker.

params.name: travel
params.description: Key travel depth: how far a pressed keycap sinks into its well, from no visible movement (0) to full 4 px throw (1).

components.name: pr_metronome
components.description: A pyramid-shaped wooden metronome with a light front panel, ruled scale marks, and a pendulum rod swinging an ochre weight, with small teal ripple notes pulsing beside it; anchored at the bottom centre, 190×250 px. Useful as a desk or shelf prop in a music room or practice scene, and its swing can be sped up or slowed.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians; shifts the swing and ripple cycle so several copies tick out of sync.

params.name: bpm
params.description: Swing speed multiplier; 0 freezes the pendulum nearly still, 1 gives the full ticking rate.

components.name: pr_microwave
components.description: A watercolour microwave with a rounded pale-grey shell, a left-hinged door holding a large dark window, and a side control panel with display, button grid and dial. Its lit cavity shows a turntable, bowl and steam, and it is 420×300 px anchored at bottom centre, suited to kitchen counters and appliance props.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that desynchronises the door cycle, blinking display and dial wiggle between copies.

params.name: on
params.description: Switches the interior light and warm glow on (1) or off (0), also softening the cavity illumination.

params.name: door
params.description: Door swing: -1 runs the automatic open/close cycle, values 0 to 1 hold the door at a fixed angle from shut to fully open.

components.name: pr_milk_carton
components.description: A watercolour gable-top milk carton in cream paper with a pale blue label band, milk-drop motif, printed lines and a folded seam along the roof ridge; it sways gently and dribbles drops when not full. Anchor is bottom centre, 180×245 px, sized for a tabletop, fridge shelf or breakfast scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that desynchronises the gentle sway (and the drip timing) between copies of the carton.

params.name: full
params.description: Fill level of the carton; at 1 no milk escapes, and below 1 pale drops spill from the right side, becoming more visible as the value drops.

components.name: pr_mirror_self
components.description: A watercolour standing oval mirror on a small wooden base with two angled struts, its ochre frame enclosing pale glass that shows a faint abstract figure with a glowing rose heart. The highlight streak drifts across the glass; 250×290 px with the anchor at bottom centre, suited to interior scenes and quiet self-reflection moments.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the shimmer and heart-pulse animation in radians so multiple copies do not pulse in sync.

params.name: shimmer
params.description: Strength of the moving white highlight band on the glass; 0 keeps it nearly still and faint.

components.name: pr_moon_lantern
components.description: A watercolour crescent-moon lantern suspended from a short cord, with a warm pulsing halo, a few star flecks, a small hanging ring and a teal bead pendant below. Anchor is bottom centre, 200×300 px; suited to night scenes hung under eaves, branches or shop fronts.

params.name: glow
params.description: Strength of the warm halo around the moon and the opacity of the star flecks; 0 leaves a flat, unlit lantern.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians for the swing and glow pulse, so multiple copies animate out of sync.

components.name: pr_mop_bucket
components.description: A watercolour mop bucket with a wire carry handle, a front rim lip, and a mop resting in it: wooden handle with a brass ferrule, a metal clamp gripping nine cloth strips that hang down into the water. Bubbles, a damp rim ring, and a small puddle on the floor sit around it; anchor is bottom centre, 320×486 px, good for household, cleaning, or chore scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the sway, strip wiggle, and bubble animation so repeated copies do not move in sync.

params.name: soak
params.description: Wetness of the mop: increases the sway of the handle and cloth strips, the damp ring on the rim, and the bubble count/opacity.

params.name: water
params.description: Water level in the bucket; brightens and strengthens the water surface sheen and the size/opacity of the puddle on the floor.

components.name: pr_moss_patch
components.description: A rounded grey pebble capped by a lobed layer of green watercolour moss, with fine fuzz strokes, thin spore stalks, a few dew drops and a damp shadow at its base. It measures 320×200 px with the anchor at the bottom centre, and works as a small ground detail on a forest floor, garden bed or stone path.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the wobble of the moss edge and spore stalks, used to desynchronise multiple copies.

params.name: damp
params.description: Wetness level: controls the opacity of the dew drops and the damp stain around the base of the stone.

params.name: spores
params.description: Density and opacity of the slender spore stalks rising from the moss; below 0.2 they are hidden entirely.

components.name: pr_motorcycle
components.description: A watercolour side view of a motorcycle with two spoked wheels, mudguards, a teardrop fuel tank, stepped seat, finned engine block, curved exhaust pipe, headlamp and mirrors. It is 510×290 px with its anchor at the bottom centre, and works as a parked or idling street prop in roadside and town scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians for the idle bob and exhaust cycle, used to desynchronise multiple copies.

params.name: idle
params.description: Amount of engine idling: vertical bob of the body and puffing exhaust from the tailpipe; 0 freezes it completely.

params.name: tank
params.description: Colour scheme of the fuel tank and mudguards: warm ochre, blue-green teal, or dusty rose.

components.name: pr_mushroom_row
components.description: A watercolour cluster of three mushrooms with rose, orange and clay caps, pale spots, inked gills and cream stems, standing on a soft moss patch with small drifting spore lights. It is 260×200 px with its anchor at the bottom centre, and works as a woodland-floor accent or foreground detail in an outdoor scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the swaying motion and spore bobbing, used to desynchronise copies.

params.name: spores
params.description: Density and brightness of the floating spore lights around the caps; 0 removes them entirely.

components.name: pr_mv_flower
components.description: One big yellow watercolour flower on a green stem with two leaves; grow 0→1 raises the stem, opens the leaves, then the six petals one by one (animate grow with a Track). Gently sways. Flower centre ~ 3.6 × size px above the anchor (≈ 110 px at size 30)

params.name: grow
params.description: stem → leaves → petals

params.name: size
params.description: petal radius in px (the whole flower scales with it)

params.name: sway
params.description: how much it sways in the breeze

params.name: rich
params.description: darker pigment inside the petals (hero flower)

components.name: pr_mv_flower_bunch
components.description: A patch of 3–12 yellow watercolour flowers of mixed heights swaying out of step; grow 0→1 makes them sprout one after another (animate it with a Track). About 9 × size px wide (≈ 230 px at size 26), flowers up to ~ 4.5 × size px tall

params.name: grow
params.description: sprouting progress of the whole patch

params.name: count
params.description: number of flowers

params.name: size
params.description: average petal radius in px

components.name: pr_mv_swing
components.description: Wooden A-frame swing (460 px wide, beam 300 px high) swinging on the 69 BPM beat, optionally with the Clawd girl or boy on the seat swinging with it (the rider is part of this component: do not add a separate character). pose: sit, stand, squat, pump = stands up at the bottom of each swing and squats at the ends (how you pump a swing higher), or mistimed = the opposite (stands at the ends, squats at the bottom: the swing dies down)

params.name: rider
params.description: who sits on the seat

params.name: emotion
params.description: rider emotion (all 31 of ch_clawd_girl / ch_clawd_boy)

params.name: amp
params.description: swing angle in radians (0 = still; 0.35 ≈ 20°, 0.87 ≈ 50°, 1 ≈ 57°)

params.name: pose
params.description: rider pose; pump = stand at the bottom, squat at the ends; mistimed = the other way round

components.name: pr_neon_sign
components.description: A dark rectangular backplate with glowing neon tube lettering spelling "OPEN", plus a small inward arrow and three dot ornaments, all drawn in loose watercolour with a soft halo and a flickering pulse. It measures 280×230 px with the anchor at the bottom centre, and works hung on a shopfront, wall or interior scene as a lit sign.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the flicker cycle, so multiple copies do not pulse in sync.

params.name: on
params.description: Lit or dark: 1 draws the full glow and bright tubes, 0 dims the tubes to a faint unlit outline with no halo.

params.name: hue
params.description: Palette colour of the neon tubes and glow: rose pink, teal green-blue, or ochre amber.

components.name: pr_office_chair
components.description: A watercolour office chair drawn in profile with a five-star base, gas lift, seat, tall backrest with stitching, headrest, lumbar pad and two armrests, anchored at the bottom centre at 270×320 px. It sways gently in place, making it useful as a desk or study prop in interior scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offset in radians that shifts the sway timing, so several chairs do not rock in unison.

params.name: spin
params.description: Multiplier for the sway amount; 0 keeps the chair still, higher values increase the rocking.

components.name: pr_open_book
components.description: An open watercolour book seen from a slight front angle, with two curved cream pages of wobbly ink text lines, a small green illustration panel, a brown spine and a rose bookmark ribbon, flanked by two upright books leaning behind it. It measures 420×230 px and anchors at the bottom centre, making it a good tabletop or desk prop for study, library and reading scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that desynchronises the ribbon sway and page flutter between copies.

params.name: page
params.description: Amount of page flutter; above 0.2 the right page corner lifts and waves, growing with the value.

components.name: pr_parcel_box
components.description: A watercolour cardboard parcel box seen from a slight top-down angle, with four flaps folded outward, crumpled packing filler and a small rose-coloured item visible inside, a tape strip down the front, a shipping label with barcode and two fragile marks. Anchor is bottom centre at 360×300 px; it works as a doorstep, porch or delivery-scene prop.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that desynchronises the lid sway between copies of the box.

params.name: open
params.description: How far the box is opened: 0 keeps it shut with no flaps or contents, 1 folds all four flaps out and reveals the filler and item inside.

params.name: tape
params.description: Opacity and strength of the packing-tape strip running down the front of the box; 0 removes it.

components.name: pr_pavlov_bell
components.description: A watercolour brass handbell with an arched handle and a swinging clapper, drawn beside a small metal food bowl holding two treats, with faint teal sound arcs and a dotted arrow linking bell to bowl. It sits on its shadow at the bottom-centre anchor in a 260×230 px box and is suited to classroom, psychology or laboratory scenes as a small ground prop.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the animation timing in radians, desynchronising swing, sound waves and arrow dots between copies.

params.name: ring
params.description: Amount of ringing: scales the bell's rocking tilt, the clapper swing and the opacity of the sound arcs; 0 leaves it silent and still.

components.name: pr_pebble_pile
components.description: A watercolour cluster of rounded pebbles arranged in layered rows, with small scattered stones, soft highlights, contact shadows, and a faint wet-sand ring. It is anchored at the bottom centre and measures 320×170 px, suitable for ground cover, rocky patches, or shoreline details.

params.name: wet
params.description: Controls the strength of the damp sheen and wet ground tint; higher values make the pile look wetter.

components.name: pr_pen_holder
components.description: A watercolour desk pen holder: a tapered brown cylindrical cup with an elliptical rim and base, holding a pencil, a ballpoint pen, a paintbrush and a slanted ruler that sway slightly; an eraser and a small clip sit at its foot. It is 240×250 px with the anchor at the bottom centre, and is good for populating a desk, studio or office scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that desynchronises the pen sway between multiple copies.

params.name: wobble
params.description: Amount the pens and ruler sway inside the cup; 0 keeps them still.

components.name: pr_persona_masks
components.description: Two watercolour theatre masks hang from cords, a pale smiling mask in front and a darker weeping mask behind, anchored at the bottom centre and sized 280×240 px. Useful as a wall-hung or handheld symbol of persona, mood, or performance in a scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the gentle swaying animation in radians; use different values to desynchronise multiple copies.

params.name: flip
params.description: Sets facing direction: -1 faces left and 1 faces right; values in between reduce the swing and lean.

components.name: pr_platform_bench
components.description: A watercolour station bench with cast-iron legs, a wooden slat seat and backrest, armrests, a folded newspaper, and an optional seated passenger. Anchored at bottom centre and 420×270 px, it suits platform, waiting-area, or street scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians; desynchronises the gentle sway and newspaper flutter between copies.

params.name: occupied
params.description: Adds a seated passenger silhouette when above 0.5; higher values also increase the small swaying motion.

params.name: paper
params.description: Fades the folded newspaper on the seat; 0 removes it and 1 shows it fully.

components.name: pr_power_strip
components.description: A watercolour extension lead seen slightly from above: a long pale rounded body with four sockets, a rocker switch with a blinking orange indicator, and up to two plugs with trailing cords. Anchored at bottom centre and 400×170 px, it suits desks, floors or workshop scenes as a small electrical prop.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians for the blinking indicator and cord sway; change it to desynchronise multiple strips.

params.name: on
params.description: Turns the strip on or off; values above 0.5 light the switch and make the orange indicator blink.

params.name: plugs
params.description: Number of plugs to show plugged in; the artwork draws up to two plug shapes.

components.name: pr_rail_track
components.description: A watercolour railway track receding in perspective, with two steel rails, wooden sleepers that crowd toward the horizon, gravel ballast, and a faint tunnel mouth with a small green signal light at the vanishing point. Anchored at the bottom centre, 520×240 px, it works as a ground-level prop for platforms, countryside or tunnel-mouth scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the timing of the gravel rattle so several copies of the track do not shake in unison.

params.name: rattle
params.description: Amount of side-to-side jitter on the foreground gravel stones; 0 is still, 1 is a lively tremble.

components.name: pr_rain_cloud
components.description: A soft watercolour cumulus cloud with a wavy flat base, drifting gently while ink rain streaks fall from it, occasional lightning flashes, and small splash arcs on the ground beneath. Anchored at the bottom centre and about 308×278 px, it suits outdoor sky and weather scenes above ground level.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the drift, puff breathing, rain and splash cycles, useful for desynchronising several clouds.

params.name: rain
params.description: Amount of rain: at 0 the falling ink streaks disappear, at 1 they are at full length and opacity.

params.name: mood
params.description: Palette key used for the cloud's wash colour, changing the overall tone of the body.

components.name: pr_range_hood
components.description: A watercolour kitchen range hood: a narrow chimney duct rising to the top edge, a wide inverted-trapezoid canopy, a round fan grille with spinning blades, a grease cup below, and a small button panel on the right, with faint steam drifting underneath. Anchor is bottom centre, 440×300 px, sized to hang above a stove or counter in kitchen scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that desynchronises the fan spin and steam motion between copies.

params.name: fan
params.description: Fan speed and steam amount; 0 stops the blades and hides the steam, higher values spin faster and draw more steam.

components.name: pr_refrigerator
components.description: A watercolour refrigerator with a freezer compartment above and a fridge compartment below, both stocked with food and opening on hinges to reveal shelves and door racks. Notes, magnets, a bowl and a jar sit on its exterior; anchored at the bottom centre at 300×425 px, it suits a kitchen or home interior scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians, used to desynchronise copies of the animation.

params.name: note
params.description: Amount of notes and magnets shown on the refrigerator doors.

params.name: door
params.description: Door swing: -1 runs the automatic opening and closing cycle, 0 keeps both doors shut, and 1 holds both doors fully open.

components.name: pr_rice_cooker
components.description: A watercolour rice cooker drawn as a barrel-shaped cream body with a domed lid, ochre knob, steam vent, side clamps, and a front control panel with two buttons and a glowing warm-keep light; two thin steam wisps rise from the vent. Sized 260×215 px with the anchor at bottom centre, it suits a kitchen countertop, shelf, or appliance corner of a domestic scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that desynchronises the warm-keep light pulse and the steam sway between copies.

params.name: warm
params.description: Strength of the warm-keep indicator: 0 leaves the light almost dark, 1 gives the full pulsing orange glow.

components.name: pr_ripple_rings
components.description: A shallow water puddle with three concentric ripple rings, a small splash and floating droplets at the centre, and broken highlight strokes along the surface. The 420×190 px prop is anchored at its bottom centre and works as ground-level water detail in a scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the ripple animation and puddle outline so multiple copies do not pulse in sync.

params.name: strength
params.description: How far the rings expand and contract with the animation; 0 keeps them nearly still, 1 gives the widest breathing motion.

params.name: drops
params.description: Opacity and visibility of the central splash and flying droplets; below 0.2 the splash is omitted entirely.

components.name: pr_road_barrier
components.description: A watercolour road barrier with an A-frame stand, a red-and-white diagonally striped horizontal board, small ochre reflectors, and a blinking orange warning lamp on top. It is 280×190 px with the anchor at the bottom centre, suitable for street works, construction sites, or blocking a path in a scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians; shifts the board wobble and warning-light blink cycle to desynchronise copies.

params.name: blink
params.description: Controls how strongly the board wobbles and the warning lamp glows/blinks; 0 disables both, 1 is full effect.

components.name: pr_roller_shutter
components.description: A watercolour roller shutter for a shopfront or garage: a grey corrugated metal curtain hanging from a top roller box, with a dark doorway behind, a pull handle, graffiti and tape, and a small number plate. It is 336×360 px with the anchor at bottom centre, suitable as a street-level facade prop that can be raised or lowered.
