params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians (default 0); shifts the small wobble animation so multiple shutters do not move in sync.

params.name: open
params.description: Open amount (default 0.25): 0 leaves the shutter fully shut, 1 lifts it fully open.

components.name: pr_rubber_hand
components.description: A watercolour scene of the rubber-hand illusion: a pale rubber hand lies flat on a small table, a wooden divider hides a real hand peeking out behind it, and a brush sweeps back and forth over the fake hand with faint teal motion marks. Anchor is bottom centre, 300×210 px; useful for psychology-lab interiors, close-up inserts or classroom diagrams.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the brush sweep and finger wobble, so several copies do not animate in sync.

params.name: stroke
params.description: Stroke intensity: scales the brush's travel distance and the opacity of the teal motion trails (0 keeps the brush nearly still with no trails).

components.name: pr_rug
components.description: A watercolour area rug drawn as a slightly tapered trapezoid with layered borders, a diamond or block motif, warp lines and fringe at both short ends. It is anchored at bottom centre and measures 460×260 px, suitable for placing under furniture or defining a floor area in an interior scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians; shifts the ripple and fringe sway to desynchronise repeated rugs.

params.name: pattern
params.description: Selects the motif: 'diamond' draws diamond medallions, 'grid' draws an alternating block grid.

params.name: lift
params.description: Controls the ripple and fringe sway amplitude; 0 is still and 1 is full motion.

components.name: pr_sandcastle
components.description: A watercolour sandcastle with a central keep and two flanking towers topped by crenellations, an arched gate, a small shell and pebbles at its base, and a thin pole with a flapping orange pennant. It measures 300×190 px with its anchor at the bottom centre, and suits beach, seaside or children's-play scenes on the ground.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the flag flutter and drifting sand-grain animation, used to desynchronise multiple copies.

params.name: flag
params.description: Visibility/strength of the pennant on top of the keep; 0 removes the flag and pole, 1 shows the full fluttering flag.

components.name: pr_saucepan
components.description: A small watercolour saucepan with a stubby wooden handle, a pouring lip on the left, a hanging loop at the handle end, and a wooden spoon resting across the rim; wisps of steam rise when it is hot. It measures 380×220 px with its anchor at the bottom centre, and suits a stove top, a kitchen shelf, or hanging on a wall.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians for the steam animation, used to desynchronise several copies of the pan.

params.name: heat
params.description: Heat level: scales the amount of soup visible in the pan and the opacity and presence of the rising steam (steam only appears above 0.3).

params.name: tilt
params.description: Rotates the pan body, handle and spoon slightly clockwise (up to about 5 degrees) as if tipped; the steam stays upright.

components.name: pr_security_grille
components.description: A watercolour window cage: a warm lit window behind a protruding iron security grille with nine vertical bars, four horizontal bars, weld spots, a padlock, rust streaks and a small blinking red alarm lamp. Anchor is bottom centre, 344×310 px; useful as a facade or wall-mounted detail for shuttered shops, back alleys or guarded houses.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians for the alarm lamp blink, used to desynchronise copies.

params.name: lamp
params.description: Brightness of the warm glow inside the window behind the bars; 0 leaves the room dark.

components.name: pr_shower_head
components.description: A wall-mounted watercolour shower head: a vertical pipe with a rounded elbow and horizontal arm holds a tilted round disc with teal spray nozzles, and animated water streams fall from it to a small floor drain below. Anchor is bottom centre at 250×320 px; it suits bathroom interiors and washing or morning-routine scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the swing and water-stream animation so multiple copies do not move in sync.

params.name: water
params.description: Amount of falling water: 0 removes the streams entirely, 1 gives full-length streams with droplets.

components.name: pr_sign_board
components.description: A watercolour hanging shop sign: a wooden board with a cream inset panel showing a coffee cup and two lines of lettering, suspended by two rings from a grey wrought-iron bracket on a plastered wall with faint brick lines. Anchored at the bottom centre at 300×250 px, it is suited to café fronts, shop facades and street scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the rocking cycle so repeated copies do not sway in unison.

params.name: swing
params.description: Swing amount; 0 keeps the board hanging still, 1 gives the full gentle rocking motion.

components.name: pr_signpost
components.description: A watercolour wooden signpost: a clay-brown post with two arrow-shaped boards (ochre pointing right, teal pointing left), a small rose flag on top, and a tuft of grass at the base. Anchored at the bottom centre at 240×290 px, it sways gently and suits roadside, garden or village scenes as a wayfinding prop.

params.name: sway
params.description: Amount the two boards rock back and forth; 0 keeps them still.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians for the sway and flag motion, to desynchronise copies of the signpost.

components.name: pr_skateboard
components.description: A side-view watercolour skateboard with a warm wooden deck, dark grip-tape top, two grey trucks and four yellow wheels that spin as the board leans and rocks in place. It sits 420×150 px with the anchor at the bottom centre and includes faint speed lines, making it useful as a ground prop for street scenes or a character's ride.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the wheel-spin and lean animation cycle in radians, so duplicate boards do not move in sync.

params.name: roll
params.description: Speed of wheel rotation; above 0.2 it also fades in trailing speed lines behind the deck.

params.name: tilt
params.description: Adds a constant lean to the board on top of the gentle rocking motion.

components.name: pr_sketchbook
components.description: An open watercolour sketchbook lying flat, with a clay-toned cover, cream page block, ink sketches of a leaf, sun and sailboat, a lifting page that flutters, an orange bookmark ribbon and a pencil resting across the top. Anchor is bottom centre at 320×150 px; good as a desk or table prop in a studio, study or artist's scene.

params.name: flip
params.description: Facing and page-lift switch: values above 0 draw the animated lifted page, values at or below 0 keep the book flat.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians for the page flutter and pencil wobble, used to desynchronise multiple copies.

components.name: pr_skinner_box
components.description: A watercolour acrylic Skinner box with a lever, food-dispenser opening and pellets, an abstract mouse silhouette inside, and a paper strip recording a behaviour curve. Anchored at the bottom centre at 270×250 px, it suits psychology or laboratory scenes as a floor-standing prop.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that desynchronises the lever, mouse, pellet and tail animations between copies.

params.name: press
params.description: Controls how far the lever is pressed and animated.

components.name: pr_snail_mailbox
components.description: A watercolour snail mailbox on a wooden post, with a domed pale-blue box, front door and handle, a small red flag, and a tiny snail perched on the side. Anchor is bottom centre at 230×280 px, suited to garden, cottage, or roadside scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the idle sway and snail bob animation; use different values to desynchronise copies.

params.name: flag
params.description: Controls the red flag: 0 hides it, 1 shows it.

components.name: pr_snow_pile
components.description: A watercolour snow pile: a broad flat ground drift with two rounded domes of white snow, soft blue shadow bands at the base, a few bare twigs poking out and a twinkling sparkle cross. Anchor is bottom centre, 420×240 px; good for dressing winter ground, paths or yard edges in a scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that desynchronises the sparkle twinkle between multiple copies of the pile.

params.name: sparkle
params.description: Amount of animated sparkle: below 0.2 the glitter crosses are hidden, higher values fade them in at full brightness.

components.name: pr_speed_bump
components.description: A watercolour speed bump shown as a black-and-yellow striped hump on a grey road patch with faded lane edges and two white road arrows. It is anchored at the bottom centre and measures 340×160 px, suitable for street scenes or traffic-calming props.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the wet-reflection shimmer cycle to desynchronise multiple copies.

params.name: wet
params.description: Increases the wet road reflection and sheen beneath the bump.

components.name: pr_spice_rack
components.description: A small wooden two-post spice rack with three shelf boards holding glass spice jars with metal pierced lids, a pepper mill, two short jars, a mortar and pestle, and a little lidded pot on top; all pieces sit on the shelf surfaces and sway slightly. It is 360×340 px with its anchor at the bottom centre, sized to stand on a kitchen counter or shelf as a background prop.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the gentle swaying animation, so several racks do not move in sync.

params.name: jars
params.description: Number of glass spice jars on the lower shelf; values are clamped to 1–3 jars, spread evenly across the board.

params.name: fill
params.description: How full the lower spice jars are, raising the coloured spice level inside each glass body.

components.name: pr_steak_board
components.description: A watercolour wooden steak board with a handle and hanging hole, topped by a seared steak with a pale fat edge, rosemary sprig, pepper specks, meat juices and a small knife at the right. It is 420×230 px with its anchor at the bottom centre, suitable as a tabletop kitchen or dining prop.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians; shifts the animated meat-juice wobble to desynchronise copies.

params.name: pepper
params.description: Amount of black pepper specks scattered over the steak; 0 hides them and 1 shows the full amount.

components.name: pr_sticky_note_stack
components.description: A small stack of pastel watercolour sticky notes with ruled ink lines, a paperclip at the top left and a pencil resting at the right, anchored at the bottom centre in a 240×190 px footprint. Useful as a desk or tabletop prop in study, office or note-taking scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the gentle wobble of the notes and pencil, so multiple copies do not move in sync.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of sticky notes in the stack; values are clamped between 1 and 4 visible sheets.

components.name: pr_sticky_notes_wall
components.description: A watercolour corkboard panel framed in wood, holding up to three pastel sticky notes with folded corners and scribbled lines, plus a small checklist paper pinned below. Anchored at the bottom centre and sized 360×320 px, it suits an office or study wall as background decor behind a desk scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians for the notes' sway animation, used to desynchronise copies of the prop.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of sticky notes drawn; the layout only defines three notes, so values are clamped to 1–3 (0 also shows one).

params.name: curl
params.description: Amount of paper sway/curl motion; 0 keeps the notes still, 1 gives the full gentle flutter.

components.name: pr_stock_pot
components.description: A wide stainless stock pot with two loop side handles, a slightly tilted glass lid with a dark knob, a pale soup surface with bubbles when uncovered, and optional steam wisps and a small burner flame underneath. Drawn in loose watercolour washes with ink outlines, 320×280 px, anchored at the bottom centre, it is good for kitchen, hearth or market-cooking scenes on a counter or stove.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the steam and lid-jiggle timing so several pots do not animate in sync.

params.name: heat
params.description: Raises steam opacity and wobble and brightens the small flame ring under the pot; below 0.3 no steam is drawn.

params.name: lid
params.description: Controls the lid: above 0.2 the glass lid appears and bobs, below 0.5 the soup surface and bubbles are also visible.

components.name: pr_stone_stack
components.description: A watercolour cairn of five rounded stones stacked from largest to smallest, with a grassy base ring and a few blades sprouting from the top stone. Anchored at the bottom centre at 220×260 px, it works as a small ground prop in gardens, paths or outdoor landscape scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that desynchronises the stone wobble and grass sway between copies.

params.name: wobble
params.description: Amount of gentle rocking applied to the stacked stones; 0 keeps the stack still.

params.name: grass
params.description: Amount of grass around the base and on top; 0 removes the grass entirely.

components.name: pr_storm_cloud
components.description: A watercolour storm cloud made of stacked grey puffs with a soft dark underside, drifting side to side and dropping thin rain streaks; during brief pulses a jagged lightning bolt, side fork and warm glow appear inside. Anchored at the bottom centre and 460×330 px, it suits a sky or backdrop element in a rainy or dramatic outdoor scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the drift bob and lightning pulse so several copies do not move or flash in sync.

params.name: drift
params.description: Amount of horizontal sway and per-puff bobbing; 0 keeps the cloud still, higher values make it rock and churn more.

params.name: lightning
params.description: Strength of the lightning effect; 0 disables the bolt and glow entirely, higher values make the flash brighter and more frequent in the pulse cycle.

components.name: pr_stratus_cloud
components.description: A watercolour stratus cloud drawn as three stacked, overlapping flat bands that widen toward the bottom, with a white-lit top edge, a shaded underside and thin drifting brush filaments. It is 480×210 px with the anchor at the bottom centre and suits a sky layer or overcast weather backdrop; the grey tone adds short rain streaks below the base.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the internal wave and wobble of the cloud, used to desynchronise several copies.

params.name: drift
params.description: Amount of horizontal sway of the cloud bands and filaments over time; 0 keeps it still.

params.name: tone
params.description: Colour scheme: 'day' pale blue-white, 'dusk' pink-mauve, 'grey' overcast grey which also adds falling rain streaks under the cloud.

components.name: pr_street_lamp
components.description: A watercolour street lamp with a stepped stone base, a tall slim post ringed with ochre bands, and a curved arm holding a trapezoid lantern that glows warm yellow with a light cone and circling insects. Anchor is bottom centre, 210×400 px; it suits street, square or park scenes, especially evening and night settings.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that desynchronises the flicker, sway and insect orbits between copies.

params.name: on
params.description: Switches the lantern between lit (1) and unlit (0), changing the glass colour, glow and light cone.

params.name: sway
params.description: Amount the curved arm and lantern swing back and forth; 0 keeps the arm still.

components.name: pr_subway_car
components.description: A side-on watercolour subway car standing on a short platform strip, with a pale body, teal and ochre livery bands, three double doors, warm-lit side windows, roof vents, two bogies with wheels, a headlight and a destination board. It is 700×300 px with its anchor at the bottom centre, and suits station platforms, transit scenes and background rail traffic.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offset in radians for the sway, light flicker and speed-line cycle, so repeated copies animate out of sync.

params.name: speed
params.description: Overall motion amount: above 0.35 drifting speed lines appear beside the car, and above 0.5 the body sways sideways.

params.name: doors
params.description: Door opening: 0 keeps the double doors closed, 1 slides both leaves fully apart.

components.name: pr_sun_moon
components.description: Big glowing sky body: warm sun, full moon or crescent moon, with a soft halo; centre is 210 px above the anchor. Animate y to make it rise or set

params.name: body
params.description: which body

params.name: glow
params.description: halo strength

params.name: rays
params.description: hand-drawn sun rays (sun only)

components.name: pr_suspension_bridge
components.description: A watercolour suspension bridge with rocky banks, a sagging plank deck, two rope handrails with hangers, end posts, and two small floating hearts above the span; a soft shadow sits at the bottom-centre anchor. It is 380×250 px and is good for scenes of crossing a gap, connection, or a light romantic or psychological motif.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that desynchronises the bridge sway and floating-heart motion between copies.

params.name: sway
params.description: Amount of deck and handrail sway; 0 keeps the bridge still, higher values increase the motion.

components.name: pr_swing_gauge
components.description: Hand-painted half-dial "how high does the swing go" meter on a little wooden stand: ticks every 10° from 0 (left) to 90 (right), a cool-to-warm watercolour band, an ink needle that eases to deg (Track it to show the swing growing or not), and a faint ghost needle at peak. Dial 300 px wide, centre ~ 70 px above the anchor

params.name: deg
params.description: swing angle the needle shows

params.name: peak
params.description: ghost needle at the best so far (0 = hidden)

components.name: pr_teapot
components.description: A watercolour teapot with a rounded body, arc handle, angled spout, lid, base, small floral motifs, and optional rising steam. It is 250×210 px with the anchor at bottom centre, making it suitable as a tabletop prop in kitchen, tea-time, or interior scenes.

params.name: steam
params.description: Steam strength; 0 removes the steam lines, higher values increase visibility.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians to desynchronise bobbing and steam animation between copies.

components.name: pr_toaster
components.description: A rounded retro two-slot toaster with a chrome-grey body, a slanted lid with two dark slots, an orange side lever, an ochre dial, and two slices of toast rising from the slots with steam wisps and crumbs. Anchor is bottom centre at 250×210 px, sized to sit on a counter or table in a kitchen scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the pop-up and steam animation cycle, used to desynchronise several toasters in one scene.

params.name: pop
params.description: Strength of the popping motion: 0 keeps the toast still and the lever fixed, 1 gives the full up-and-down bounce of toast and lever.

params.name: toast
params.description: Amount of toast present: below 0.2 the slices are hidden, above 0.4 the steam wisps fade in.

components.name: pr_towel_rack
components.description: A watercolour wall-mounted towel rack with a wooden bar, a large draped towel, a small square towel and a rolled towel, anchored at bottom centre and sized 280×300 px. It suits bathroom, kitchen or laundry wall scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the towel sway and flutter animation; useful for desynchronising multiple racks.

params.name: hue
params.description: Selects the palette colour of the large hanging towel.

components.name: pr_toy_blocks
components.description: Three stacked watercolour toy cubes lettered A, B and C, with a fourth block lying tipped on the ground, each cube drawn with a shaded top and side face. Anchor is bottom centre at 284×220 px, suited to nursery, playroom or child's-floor scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the wobble timing so multiple copies do not rock in unison.

params.name: wobble
params.description: Amount of gentle rocking applied to each block; 0 keeps them still, higher values increase the sway.

components.name: pr_traffic_light
components.description: A watercolour traffic light with a dark three-lamp housing on a slim pole, plus a side pedestrian signal; anchor is bottom centre and size is 210×350 px. Useful as a street-side prop in urban or roadside scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians; shifts the light cycle so copies do not switch in sync.

params.name: cycle
params.description: Animation speed for the signal cycle; 0 freezes the lights and 1 runs at full speed.

components.name: pr_trash_can
components.description: A watercolour rubbish bin with a tapered, ribbed body, two hoops, and a slightly ajar lid with handle and hinge; a recycling mark sits on the front, scraps of paper lie at its base, and overflowing rubbish can poke over the rim. Drawn at 190×250 px with its anchor at the bottom centre, it is a street or yard prop for cluttering ground-level scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that desynchronises the lid wobble and paper scrap motion between copies.

params.name: full
params.description: Fill level; above 0.2 rubbish bulges over the rim, at 0 the can reads as empty.

params.name: wind
params.description: Strength of the wind-driven rocking of the loose lid.

components.name: pr_tree_canopy
components.description: A watercolour tree canopy built from overlapping leafy lobes in layered light and dark washes, with fine ink outline fragments, scattered single leaves and a small hanging branch. Anchor is bottom centre at 460×440 px; it sits on a trunk as foliage for park, forest or garden scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the wind sway cycle in radians so several canopies do not move in unison.

params.name: wind
params.description: Strength of the sway and bobbing of the leaf lobes; above 0.4 a few loose leaves drift off to the right.

params.name: season
params.description: Chooses the palette: summer green, pale fresh spring green, or warm gold and rust autumn tones.

params.name: density
params.description: Number of fluffy edge blobs around each lobe; lower values give a sparser, more open silhouette.

components.name: pr_tree_trunk
components.description: A watercolour tree trunk with a slightly tapered, curved body, flared roots at the base, bark streaks, a knot and patches of moss, topped by three short forks where a canopy can attach. It is 240×500 px with the anchor at the bottom centre and stands on the ground, useful as the stable base beneath a separate swaying crown.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the timing of the gentle top sway, so copies do not move in sync.

params.name: wind
params.description: Strength of the small side-to-side sway at the top of the trunk; 0 keeps it still.

params.name: moss
params.description: Amount of green moss patches on the trunk; values below 0.2 hide them.

components.name: pr_umbrella
components.description: A watercolour umbrella with a scalloped teal canopy split into alternating pale panels, ink ribs, a hooked handle and a small ochre finial, with a few blue raindrops drifting beneath it. It is 280×320 px with the anchor at the bottom centre of the handle, and it suits rainy street or garden scenes as a handheld or leaning prop.

params.name: sway
params.description: Amount the umbrella rocks side to side as it sways; 0 holds it still.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the sway and raindrop cycle in radians so several copies do not move in sync.

params.name: open
params.description: How far the canopy is unfurled; 0 gives a narrow shut umbrella, 1 a fully open one.

components.name: pr_veggie_basket
components.description: A watercolour wicker basket with a looped handle, filled with lettuce, eggplant, carrots, tomatoes and potatoes; anchored at the bottom centre at 430×320 px. It suits a kitchen, market or harvest scene as a grounded container prop.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians; desynchronises the gentle sway animation between copies.

params.name: full
params.description: Fill level; values above 0.5 draw the handle and its mounting ears, lower values omit them.

components.name: pr_vine_trellis
components.description: A watercolour vine trellis: a wooden frame with two posts, three horizontal rails and a top beam, covered by a climbing vine with leaves, tendrils and small blossoms. The anchor is bottom centre and the size is 380×460 px, making it useful as a garden ground prop or façade decoration behind a scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that desynchronises the swaying motion of copies.

params.name: wind
params.description: Wind strength; controls how far the vine, branches, leaves and flowers sway.

params.name: flowers
params.description: Number of blossoms; 0 hides them, and higher values make the flower clusters more prominent.

components.name: pr_wall_clock
components.description: A watercolour wall clock with a wooden outer ring, pale face, fine minute ticks, dark hour and minute hands, a thin red second hand, and a hanging ring above the frame. It is 280×290 px with a bottom-centre anchor and is suited to interior wall scenes or household decor.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the animated second hand to desynchronise copies.

params.name: hour
params.description: Hour value used to set the angle of the short hour hand.

params.name: minute
params.description: Minute value used to set the angle of the long minute hand.

components.name: pr_wall_shelf
components.description: A watercolour wall shelf with two triangular wooden brackets and a broad board, holding a stack of books, a small potted plant that sways gently, a jar and three tiny coloured objects. It is 280×220 px with its anchor at the bottom centre and works as interior wall decor in a room scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the plant's sway animation cycle in radians; change it to desynchronise multiple shelf copies.

params.name: plants
params.description: Controls whether the potted plant is drawn: 0 hides it, while any value above 0 shows one plant.

components.name: pr_washing_machine
components.description: A front-loading watercolour washing machine drawn face-on: a rounded white body with a control panel of dial and buttons, a big round glass door showing coloured laundry tumbling inside, a detergent bottle on the lid and a drain hose at the right. It measures 250×326 px with the anchor at the bottom centre, and suits laundry rooms, kitchens or other domestic interior scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians; shifts the rumble and laundry tumbling cycle so several machines do not move in sync.

params.name: spin
params.description: Spin speed multiplier; 0 stops the laundry and body shake, higher values make the drum clothes circle faster and the body vibrate more.

components.name: pr_waste_basket
components.description: A woven watercolour waste basket seen slightly from above, with an oval rim, two small side grips, crumpled paper balls peeking out of the opening, and one loose paper ball resting beside the base. Anchor is bottom centre, 300×330 px; suited as a floor prop in a study, office or bedroom corner.

params.name: phase
params.description: Offsets the idle sway and paper-ball bobbing in radians so multiple baskets don't move in sync.

params.name: full
params.description: Fill level; controls how many crumpled paper balls are drawn inside the rim, from empty at 0 to all four at 1.

components.name: pr_water_drop
components.description: A watercolour teardrop-shaped water drop with a pale teal wash, white highlights, inner reflections, and a small puddle at its base. It is anchored at the bottom centre, measures 140×220 px, and suits rain, dew, puddle, or nature-scene accents.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that desynchronises copies of the drop.

params.name: wobble
params.description: Amount of side-to-side wobble in the drop outline.

params.name: shine
params.description: Opacity strength of the white highlights and reflections.

components.name: pr_watering_can
components.description: A watercolour watering can with a rounded teal body, arched handle, tapered spout with an ochre rose, and animated water streams falling from the spout; a small mound of earth with a sprouting seedling sits at its base. It is 346×210 px with the anchor at the bottom centre, and works well as a garden prop beside beds, pots, or a gardener character.

params.name: pour
params.description: Amount of water flowing from the spout; 0 hides the streams, higher values make fuller, more visible pours.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that desynchronises the stream wobble and seedling sway between copies.

params.name: hue
params.description: Palette colour used for the can body and lid.

components.name: pr_wind_chime
components.description: A hanging watercolour wind chime: a small wooden hook and cord support a two-tiered wooden disc with four staggered metal tubes in blue-green washes, and a clay-coloured wooden wind-catcher plate swings beneath on a central cord, with faint breeze lines beside it. Anchor is bottom centre, 160×300 px, suited to porches, garden eaves or window frames where a light swinging motion is wanted.

params.name: wind
params.description: Strength of the gust animation; 0 keeps the tubes and plate still, higher values swing them further and faster.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians for the swing cycle, used to desynchronise several chimes in the same scene.

components.name: pr_window_broken
components.description: A tall watercolour window frame with dark broken-out glass, jagged glass shards along the edges, radial cracks around a central impact point, and two strips of tape crossed in an X over the pane. A stone sill with scattered glass sits at the bottom centre anchor (316×300 px), with faint wind lines and a drifting leaf adding motion; it is good for dressing a weathered or abandoned facade.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that desynchronises the swaying wind and leaf animation between copies.

params.name: draft
params.description: Strength of the wind sway and leaf drift; 0 keeps the air still, 1 gives full motion.

components.name: pr_window_closed
components.description: A closed watercolour casement window with a pale frame, four-pane glass, cross mullions, a pair of gathered curtains, a sill with a small potted flowering plant, and a soft moving highlight on the glass. It measures 316×300 px with the anchor at bottom centre, and is good for dressing house and shop facades in exterior street scenes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the glass shimmer and flower sway, so repeated windows do not move in sync.

params.name: lit
params.description: How much warm interior light shows through the glass; higher values turn the panes yellow and add a stronger glow behind them.

params.name: curtain
params.description: Palette wash used for the two curtain drapes hanging at the sides of the window.

components.name: pr_window_open
components.description: A watercolour sliding window with its sash pushed open to the left, revealing a pale sky, distant hills, a sun and a small cottage; a rose curtain on the right bulges inward on the breeze, with a sill below and drifting leaves and wind lines crossing the opening. Anchor is bottom centre, 340×320 px, sized to sit into a house facade or an interior wall in a scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians that shifts the curtain sway, leaf drift and wind-line timing so copies of the window do not move in sync.

params.name: breeze
params.description: Strength of the wind: how far the curtain edge and its loose corner flap swing, and how pronounced the drifting motion reads.

components.name: pr_wooden_bench
components.description: A watercolour wooden garden bench with two backrest posts, two horizontal back slats, a slatted seat and four short legs, plus wood-grain strokes, dark nail dots and a few drifting autumn leaves above the seat. It measures 320×190 px with the anchor at the bottom centre and works well as ground-level park or garden seating in a scene.

params.name: phase
params.description: Phase offset in radians for the leaf bobbing animation, used to desynchronise multiple copies.

params.name: leaves
params.description: Number of drifting leaves and their opacity; 0 removes the leaves entirely, higher values make the falling leaves denser and more visible.

components.name: fg_kick_scribble
components.description: Frantic effort marks: magenta-violet zigzag scribbles and sweat drops bursting outward around a point, flickering on the boil — "kicking hard for nothing". power 0..1 sets how many and how big (0 = nothing). Spreads ~ 280 px wide around a centre 90 px above the anchor; put the anchor under the kicking legs

params.name: power
params.description: how hard the kicking is

components.name: fg_mv_petal_shower
components.description: Yellow petals drifting down and across the whole frame in an endless gentle stream (bursts overlap, so it never resets). Covers 1920×1080: place it at x 960, y 1080

params.name: density
params.description: petals per burst (a burst every 2 s)

params.name: wind
params.description: which way they drift

components.name: fg_reeds
components.description: Foreground clump of cattails / reeds swaying in front of everything; frame a shot edge or hide a critter peeking out

params.name: count
params.description: number of stems

params.name: sway
params.description: wind strength

params.name: dark
params.description: dark silhouette (for night or strong foreground)
